name: finance-query-site
description: A local A-share and Hong Kong stock financial statement query workspace.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @finance-query/web && npm run build --workspace @finance-query/api && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('.build-stamp', new Date().toISOString())"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @finance-query/web && npm run test --workspace @finance-query/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @finance-query/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @finance-query/api
